hint_mode.tooltip: auto: 1 mask = first frame, one mask per frame = per-frame hints, otherwise use hint_frames. keyframes: masks are placed on hint_frames.

hint_frames.tooltip: Frame number of each hint mask, e.g. '0, 48, 120' (negative counts from the end). A single number with one mask places that mask there.

propagate_backward.tooltip: When the first hint is not on frame 0, key the earlier frames by running time backwards from that hint. Off: earlier frames are keyed without a hint.

hint_quality.tooltip: Trust in the hint: 0.95 clean matte, 0.75 rough automatic mask, 0.5 or less loose hint.

carry_hint.tooltip: Feed the model's own stage-1 matte forward as a hint between overlapping temporal windows. Turn off to use per-frame hints literally.

invert_hint.tooltip: Turn on for the mask of a cutout PNG from Load Image (its MASK is 1 - alpha). Masks painted in the Mask Editor are already white = subject; leave this off.

hint_grow_px.tooltip: Grow (+) or shrink (-) the hint before keying.

hint_blur_px.tooltip: Soften the hint edges before keying.

temporal_window.tooltip: Frames per stage-1 window / step between windows. Larger windows give the spatio-temporal attention more context (steadier mattes) and need more VRAM.

hann_chunk.tooltip: Window length when temporal_window is custom.

hann_stride.tooltip: Window step when temporal_window is custom (must not exceed hann_chunk).

low_vram.tooltip: Staged inference: foundation features and stage-1 results go through disk. Exact, lower peak VRAM, slower.

vram_budget_gb.tooltip: Override the VRAM budget used for automatic choices (0 = measure).

input_colorspace.tooltip: linear: frames are scene-linear (e.g. EXR plates) and may exceed 1.0.

linear_brightness.tooltip: Experimental linear-light gain applied before the model, inverted on the foreground.

output_colorspace.tooltip: linear: unclamped scene-linear foreground (keeps HDR values, for EXR).

process_scale.tooltip: Run the model at a reduced resolution and scale the result back up. Use for 4K on smaller GPUs.

stage2_batch.tooltip: Full-resolution frames refined per stage-2 batch.

alpha_hint.tooltip: Subject hint masks, white = subject. See hint_mode and hint_frames.

output_tooltips: Stage-1 matte (half resolution, blended across temporal windows).
Stage-1 /8 decision head: which subject the model chose.
CorridorKey2Advanced.name: CorridorKey2Advanced
CorridorKey2Advanced.description: Full control over CorridorKey 2.0: hint keyframes with forward and backward propagation, the spatio-temporal attention window, low-VRAM staging, scene-linear/HDR input and output, processing scale, and the stage-1 coarse and decision mattes.
